settings.heading: About
settings.text: The City of London's finest wine shop, with an all-weather tasting terrace on historic St Swithin's Lane.

settings.heading: A destination for wine enthusiasts
settings.text: Welcome to St Swithins Wine Shippers, the City of London's finest wine shop with an all-weather tasting terrace on historic St Swithin's Lane. A destination for wine enthusiasts and connoisseurs alike, with Enomatics and Coravin.

settings.heading: Enomatics
settings.text: 48 wines on taste every weekday from our state-of-the-art Enomatic machines, where you can try a little, or a lot, of a truly diverse array of wines from around the world.

settings.heading: Coravin
settings.text: Rare, and very rare, Grand Cru wines by the glass from our Coravin extractor. Your chance to taste some of the great names and historic vintages.

settings.heading: Tasting terrace
settings.text: Platters and nibbles to match your wine, served all day out on our tasting terrace.

settings.heading: Wine gifts
settings.text: Hundreds of bottles for everyday or special occasions, plus gifts for connoisseurs: Riedel glassware and decanters, wine books, corkscrews, cigars, and Coravin machines.

settings.heading: Food
settings.text: We serve a tempting range of platters and pots on our tasting terrace throughout the day. Each platter is accompanied by our fresh bread selection. Take a table on the all-weather terrace and enjoy a charcuterie board or artisan cheeses to complement wines by the glass or by the bottle.

settings.heading: The cellar & terrace
settings.text: Wine by the glass, bottles to take home, and a terrace for lingering. Photographed at St Swithins in the City.

settings.heading: Visit
settings.text: The City's finest wine shop with an all-weather tasting terrace.

settings.heading: Come in for a glass, a bottle, or an afternoon on the terrace
settings.text: We are on historic St Swithin's Lane, close to Bank and Cannon Street stations. The shop is open Monday to Friday, 12pm–10pm.

settings.heading: Book a table
settings.text: Reserve a table on the tasting terrace. Monday to Friday, 12pm–10pm. For larger groups, email info@stswithinswineshippers.com or call 020 7621 9972.

settings.address: 11-12 St Swithin's Lane, London EC4N 8AL. Close to Bank and Cannon Street stations.

settings.heading: Wine gifts
settings.text: A bottle of wine to take home for dinner? A special bottle for a special occasion? All our wines can be gift-wrapped. Or perhaps a presentation box of vintage Champagne with its own glasses, a beautiful decanter, an antique corkscrew, a wine compendium, or a Coravin machine.

settings.heading: Coravin
settings.text: Aspiration in a glass. With our Coravin extraction you can sample rare wines that previously were beyond reach. A surgical-quality needle pierces the cork, extracts your measure, and leaves the cork to re-form. Taste a great vintage — a Domaine de la Romanée-Conti or a Château Lafite — by the glass.
